title: Breaking into a Suitcase with a Ballpoint Pen and What You Can Do About It
summary: ITS Tactical demonstrates how a ballpoint pen can open a zippered suitcase without leaving a trace, bypassing its lock, and suggests countermeasures.
why: Cited in TSA luggage-lock threads to show that locks on zippered bags offer little real security.

quote.text: Most bags can be opened and closed with a ball point pen WITHOUT A TRACE completely bypassing any locks.
